subject: Questionnaire selection, SOC 2 status & data residency clarifications after demo
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + questionnaire path & clarifying asks

Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security review moving without delays.

Recap from our call:
- You’re evaluating Redwood for chat and document-parsing workflows that will touch EU patient data and a small set of US-based test accounts.
- HIPAA coverage will be required for the clinical workflows; GDPR/data residency is a requirement for EU patient data.
- Your procurement/security team prefers a vendor questionnaire first (SIG/CAIQ) before legal review.

Open clarifying questions we need from your side to scope the questionnaire and evidence asks:
1) SOC 2 status: do you want a SOC 2 in-hand, or is a SOC 2-in-progress timeline acceptable (you mentioned target Q4 2026)?
2) If HIPAA applies, will the initial scope be ‘PHI in production’ or ‘PHI in POC only’ (affects evidence and BAA scope)?
3) Data residency: which EU country or region must the EU patient data remain in?
4) KMS/HSM requirement: do you require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-kms / HSM integration), or is Redwood-managed KMS acceptable for now?
5) Questionnaire path: do you prefer a CAIQ prefill (faster) or a custom SIG form? We can also start with CAIQ and then supply targeted custom answers where needed.

Attachments: I’ve attached our SIG process overview to show timelines and typical evidence bundles.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm questionnaire preference this week, we’ll return a prefill + evidence map within 3 business days.
- If SOC 2 in-hand is required, we’ll flag what evidence we can provide immediately vs what needs the SOC 2 final report.
- Suggest a 30-minute kickoff with your security contact next week to align owners and timelines.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate once you confirm preference and primary security contact.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Redwood_SIG_Process.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: Lena Park <lena@heliumhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@heliumhealth.com, Tom Brooks <t.brooks@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + questionnaire path & clarifying asks

Thanks, Ava — great demo yesterday. A few answers up front to help scope: 

- SOC 2: we currently do not require an in-hand third-party SOC 2 report to start procurement, but for final approval we need to see a SOC 2 Type II (targeted for our contract signing). Our internal policy allows moving forward with a SOC 2-in-progress with a clear timeline and bridge evidence. Target SOC 2 acceptance window: Q1 2027.
- HIPAA: yes, HIPAA applies for the clinical workflow (production). We will require a BAA as part of contract terms.
- Data residency: EU patient data must be stored and processed in the EU (preferably Germany or Ireland due to existing infra).
- KMS: our security team prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK) for production workloads, but we can accept Redwood-managed KMS for a POC.
- Questionnaire preference: starting with a CAIQ prefill would be fastest for our team; if gaps appear we’ll escalate to a custom SIG.

Primary security contact is Tom Brooks (cc’d). He’s the best person to align on evidence owners and technical questions. Can we schedule the kickoff on Thursday 10/3 at 10am CET?

On Thu, 2026-09-30 at 16:12, Ava Chen wrote:
> Hi Lena — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your security review moving without delays.

> - You’re evaluating Redwood for chat and document-parsing workflows that will touch EU patient data and a small set of US-based test accounts.
> - HIPAA coverage will be required for the clinical workflows; GDPR/data residency is a requirement for EU patient data.
> - Your procurement/security team prefers a vendor questionnaire first (SIG/CAIQ) before legal review.

Appreciate the quick clarity — Lena
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: evidence mapping + CAIQ prefill plan for Helium Health

Ava / Soojin — quick internal note to sync before the kickoff tonight (per Lena’s timezone). Key technical points and what I’ll prepare:

- CAIQ first: good call. I’ll start a CAIQ prefill and mark questions that require SOC 2 report excerpts or Architecture diagrams.
- SOC 2 bridge: we should prepare a one-page SOC 2 status summary (attached) that covers: timeline, what controls are already operating, interim compensating controls, and expected report date. That will satisfy procurement short-term.
- HIPAA scope: since production PHI is in scope, we need to confirm our BAA template and encryption-at-rest with BYOK path.
- Data residency: we support EU regions (Ireland/Germany) but need to confirm which EU region Helium prefers — this will drive where we point their tenant and what evidence we produce for data flow diagrams.
- Evidence owners: propose we ask Helium for the following items on kickoff: list of acceptable certs/controls, primary technical contact, expected contract signing date.

I’ll attach the CAIQ prefill spreadsheet and the SOC2_Status_Summary to the kickoff invite.

Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>

Cc: Tom Brooks <t.brooks@heliumhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + questionnaire path & clarifying asks — kickoff confirmed

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Lena & Tom — appreciated. Confirming next steps and kickoff: 

1) Kickoff: Thursday 2026-10-03 at 10:00 CET — calendar invite sent to Tom + security team.
2) Questionnaire path: we’ll start with a CAIQ prefill. Ben will deliver a first-pass prefill and an evidence map by EOD Monday 10/6 (3 business days). I’ve attached the CAIQ prefill template we’ll use so you can see the scope.
3) SOC 2/Baa: we’ll include the SOC2_Status_Summary in the prefill bundle. For the BAA, legal will be looped once we reach procurement stage — I’ll flag the BAA requirement in the kickoff so legal can attend if needed.
4) KMS and residency: Ben will call out BYOK options and the EU-region choices in the evidence map so Tom can confirm which landing zone you prefer.

Items we’ll ask from Helium during kickoff:
- Confirmation of EU country preference (Germany vs Ireland) for tenant placement
- List of additional controls/certs required for final approval
- Point-person for evidence collection (if different from Tom)

If anything else should be in scope for the prefill (e.g., penetration test report excerpt), flag it now and we’ll include it.

Thanks — we’ll be ready with the CAIQ prefill Monday and discuss the evidence owners on the kickoff.

Best,
Ava
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
